chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Abd Allah al-Barqi (may Allah have mercy on him) said: My father narrated from his grandfather Ahmad ibn Abu Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abu Nasr, who said: A man came to al-Rida (peace be upon him).

He asked: 'Does Your Lord have the power to place the heavens and the Earth and whatever is between them inside an egg? He replied: Yes, and in something even smaller than an egg. He has placed it in your eye, while it is smaller than an egg. For when you open it, you see the Sky and the Earth and whatever is in between them. If He willed, He would have blinded you from it.

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Rida (the title of Imam Musa al-Kadhim, the 7th Imam)

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Rida explain the concept of divine omnipotence regarding the size of the universe?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Tawhid*, Imam al-Rida (AS) illustrates divine omnipotence (*Qudra*) not merely as theoretical power but as an active, ongoing reality where the macrocosm is contained within the microcosm of the human eye. This concept aligns with Shia theological emphasis on God’s absolute ability to alter natural laws, serving as a profound sign (*ayah*) for human reflection on the nature of perception and creation.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 11. `Ali ibn Ahmad ibn `Abd Allah la-Barqi (RA) said: My father said, on the authority of his grandfather Ahmad ibn Abu `Abd Allah, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abu Nasr that A man came to al-Rida (AS)

and enquired: “Does Your Lord have the power to place the heavens and the Earth and whatever is between them inside an egg?” Hence, he (AS) replied, Of course he can! In fact, He has placed it in something even smaller than an egg. He has placed it all in your eye, while it is smaller than an egg. For when you open it, you see the Heavens and the Earth and whatever is in between them. IF he has willed, He would have blinded you from it all.
